definitions.explanation: A designated place where people can take refuge during disasters such as earthquakes, typhoons, or floods.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{後|あと}、{避難所|ひなんじょ}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: After the earthquake, we headed to the evacuation shelter.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くの{学校|がっこう}が{避難所|ひなんじょ}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: The nearby school is designated as an evacuation shelter.

examples.japanese: {避難所|ひなんじょ}で{数日間|すうじつかん}{生活|せいかつ}した。
examples.english: I stayed at the evacuation shelter for several days.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{避難|ひなん} (evacuation) + {所|じょ} (place)

TYPES:
・{指定|してい}{避難所|ひなんじょ} - designated evacuation shelter
・{広域|こういき}{避難所|ひなんじょ} - wide-area evacuation site
・{一時|いちじ}{避難所|ひなんじょ} - temporary evacuation shelter

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{避難所|ひなんじょ}に{避難|ひなん}する (to evacuate to a shelter)
・{避難所|ひなんじょ}を{開設|かいせつ}する (to open a shelter)
・{避難所|ひなんじょ}で{過|す}ごす (to spend time at a shelter)
・{避難所|ひなんじょ}{運営|うんえい} (shelter management)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, schools and community centers are often designated as {避難所|ひなんじょ}. Due to frequent earthquakes and typhoons, knowing your local evacuation shelter is part of disaster preparedness. Signs with 「{避難所|ひなんじょ}」 are common.

RELATED WORDS:
・{避難|ひなん} - evacuation
・{避難経路|ひなんけいろ} - evacuation route
・{防災|ぼうさい} - disaster prevention
・{備蓄|びちく} - emergency supplies/stockpile
